name: mailer
description: Provider-agnostic transactional email: adapter seam, plugin lifecycle, retries + fallback, zero runtime deps.
docs:
Provider-agnostic transactional email with zero runtime dependencies.

- `createMailer({ adapters, plugins?, retries?, backoff? })` → `{ send }`. The first adapter is primary; the rest are fallback routes tried in order, each retried with exponential backoff.
- `resend({ apiKey })` — the built-in Resend adapter, implemented over `fetch` (no SDK). Write your own `EmailAdapter` for any other provider.
- `sendEmail(input, options?)` — convenience single-provider send using `RESEND_API_KEY` from the environment; returns `{ data, error }` and never throws.
- Plugins (`beforeSend`/`afterSend`/`onRetry`/`onError`): `defaultsPlugin` (org-wide headers/tags/metadata/reply-to/idempotency), `observabilityPlugin` (redacted send/retry/error events to your logger, metrics, tracer), `capturePlugin` (record the full lifecycle for tests).
- `memoryProvider()` / `failingProvider()` — in-memory adapters for testing retries and fallback.

Set `EMAIL_DOMAIN` (verify it with your provider) and edit the display names in `src/from.ts`. Bodies are `html`/`text`; render React Email templates to HTML with the `email-templates` package, then pass the result as `html`.
